Free, open-source SEO audits inside Claude Code.
Rank higher in Google and get cited by AI search.

Install · Demo · Results · Team · Commands · Pricing · FAQ

**中文版维护：** Anhao · [X @anhao_ai](https://x.com/anhao_ai)
**GitHub：** <https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh>

> ⚠️ **免责声明（必读）**：

## 这是什么

原站是ギア（@giaaibusi）发布的三大 AI 绘画参考图库（姿势、服装、人像），元数据全部为日文，且分散在三个独立站点。本仓库（v2.0）完成了**三站合一、全量中文化、AI 角色合成工作台与 ComfyUI 原生插件升级**：

1. **三库四站全量本地镜像（11,568 张图）** —— 完整收录姿势库（素体白模 2,878 张 + 深度图 Depth 2,878 张 WebP）、服装库（2,814 张 WebP）、人像库（2,998 张，全尺寸 `1600×2000` 高清 WebP）的全部缩略图与高清原图，支持纯离线浏览与静态托管。
2. **原有图库全中文元数据** —— 动作体系、姿势分类、服装款式、穿搭标签、人像分区、发长与 51 种细分发型全部译为地道中文，自动组装的生图提示词纯净无日文干扰。
3. **三合一 AI 角色合成工作台（Web Studio）** —— 基于 **React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 + TypeScript 7 + shadcn/ui + TanStack Router** 构建的响应式多页面应用（兼容 PC / 平板 / 手机）：
   - 从三大图库任意挑选 **人像 + 服装 + 姿势（支持素体白模 / 深度图一键切换）** 组合配方，或一键随机捏人；
   - 支持拖拽、剪贴板粘贴（`Cmd+V` / `Ctrl+V`）或 URL 添加多张自定义附加参考图；
   - 内置 **5 大 AI 图像协议直连**（Google Gemini、OpenAI GPT Image、阿里云百炼 Qwen、字节火山方舟 Doubao、**本地 ComfyUI**），生成记录通过 **IndexedDB** 本地持久化保存。
4. **原生 ComfyUI 自定义节点插件（`custom_nodes`）** —— 本仓库同时是一个即插即用的 ComfyUI 插件！直接 `git clone` 到 `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/` 即可在 ComfyUI 画布内使用 **姿势 / 服装 / 人像 / 三合一角色配方** 4 个自定义节点（姿势与配方节点内置 `use_depth` 深度图切换，可直接接入 ControlNet Depth）与内置的 **4,785 条中文可视化弹窗选图器**。

---

## 核心功能

### 1. 三大参考图库（姿势 / 服装 / 人像）
- **姿势参考库（`/poses`）**：4 大体系（全身单人・标准系 / 全身单人・性感系 / 上半身单人 / 双人缠绵）、26 个动作分类、288 组姿势、5 种视角（正面 / 斜前 / 侧面 / 背面 / 俯视），支持**按姿势分组 / 逐张浏览**双模式、卡片内多角度切换，以及 **`[ 素体白模 | 深度图 (Depth) ]` 一键切换预览与下载**。
- **服装参考库（`/costumes`）**：8 大穿搭分类（春季 / 夏季 / 秋季 / 冬季 / 内衣・睡衣 / 性感穿搭 / 泳装・度假 / 派对・礼服）、86 个中文细节标签与英文 Prompt 关键词。
- **人像参考库（`/portraits`）**：2 大分区（正脸参考 893 / 造型氛围 606）、4 种发长（短发 / 中发 / 中长发 / 长发）、51 种细分发型，支持**精选题集**与**热门榜单**一键筛选。
- **统一交互体验**：中文关键词实时检索、灯箱高清原图预览与下载、一键「加入合成配方」。

### 2. AI 角色合成台（`/studio`）
- **3+N 参考图组合**：3 个核心槽位（人像 / 服装 / 姿势，姿势槽位内置 `[ 白模 | 深度 ]` 实时切换）+ 任意张自定义附加参考图（点击上传、拖拽文件、剪贴板粘贴、填写图片 URL）。
- **参考拼图预览与导出**：弹窗查看三合一高清参考拼图（`1800×1200` Canvas 实时合成），支持一键下载拼图 PNG。
- **12 种画风预设 & 纯中文结构化提示词**：内置「无预设（跟随参考图）」、写实人像写真、日韩杂志画报、复古胶片写真、2.5D 游戏原画立绘、日系二次元插画、新海诚感动画电影、日式黑白漫画网点、3D 次世代角色渲染、3D 潮玩手办质感、赛博朋克霓虹、角色设定集立绘（纯白底）共 12 种画风，根据已选素材自动组装提示词。
- **5 大 AI 图像协议与高级参数**：
  - **Google Gemini**：`gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview`、`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`、`gemini-2.5-flash-image`（支持宽高比 `aspectRatio`、分辨率 `1K/2K/4K`）
  - **OpenAI GPT Image**：`gpt-image-2.5`、`gpt-image-2`、`gpt-image-1.5`、`gpt-image-1`（支持 `/v1/images/edits` JSON URL 直传 / Multipart 上传、尺寸、质量、背景透明度）
  - **阿里云百炼 Qwen**：`qwen-image-3.0-pro`、`qwen-image-2.1-pro`、`qwen-image-2.0-pro`、`qwen-image-edit-plus`（支持 `multimodal-generation` 多图参考输入、智能改写 `prompt_extend`、水印开关）
  - **字节火山方舟 Doubao**：`doubao-seedream-5-0`、`doubao-seedream-4-5-251128`、`doubao-seedream-4-0-250828`、`doubao-seededit-3-0-i2i-250628`（支持多图融合 `image: [...]`、2K/4K 分辨率）
  - **本地 ComfyUI 工作流引擎**：支持自动将三合一拼图及单张人像/服装/姿势图上传至本地 ComfyUI（`/upload/image`），注入自定义 API 工作流占位符或自动识别节点提交 `/prompt` 队列并轮询取回成品图；支持导入/导出通用 `.api.json` 工作流模板。
- **跨页面后台生图 & IndexedDB 历史记录**：切换页面不会中断正在进行的生图请求；生成结果自动存入浏览器 IndexedDB（避免 `localStorage` 容量限制），支持复用提示词与原图下载。

> 本地 ComfyUI 三图合成（Qwen Image Edit 2509）的模型清单、工作流说明和本地运行方法见 [docs/comfyui-local.md](docs/comfyui-local.md)。

> 导入 API 后的动态高级参数、设定集参考上传与可选显示声明见 [ComfyUI 工作流高级参数](docs/comfyui-workflow-parameters.md)。

### 3. ComfyUI 原生自定义节点插件（`comfyui_plugin/`）
将本仓库克隆到 `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ai-pose-gallery-zh` 后，ComfyUI 画布右键菜单 **「AI角色三合一参考图集」** 下自动提供 4 个节点：
- **AI 姿势参考图 (`PoseGalleryNode`)**：输出 `姿势图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`姿势提示词`（支持 `use_depth` 开关一键切换输出素体白模或深度图）
- **AI 服装参考图 (`CostumeGalleryNode`)**：输出 `服装图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`中文服装描述`、`英文服装Prompt`
- **AI 人像参考图 (`PortraitGalleryNode`)**：输出 `人像图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`人像发型描述`
- **AI 角色三合一合成配方 (`CharacterRecipeNode`)**：单节点同时输出 `人像图`、`服装图`、`姿势图（支持 use_depth 深度图切换）`、`三合一拼图` 以及自动组装的 `中文合成Prompt` 与 `英文合成Prompt`，并内置 **4,785 条中文可视化弹窗选图器（含 🌗 深度图预览开关）**与节点内实时缩略图预览。

anthropics/skills.source_readme:
> **Note:** This repository contains Anthropic's implementation of skills for Claude. For information about the Agent Skills standard, see [agentskills.io](http://agentskills.io).

[![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/anthropics/skills)](https://skills.sh/anthropics/skills)

# Skills
Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to improve performance on specialized tasks. Skills teach Claude how to complete specific tasks in a repeatable way, whether that's creating documents with your company's brand guidelines, analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows, or automating personal tasks.

For more information, check out:
- [What are skills?](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512176-what-are-skills)
- [Using skills in Claude](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512180-using-skills-in-claude)
- [How to create custom skills](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512198-creating-custom-skills)
- [Equipping agents for the real world with Agent Skills](https://anthropic.com/engineering/equipping-agents-for-the-real-world-with-agent-skills)

# About This Repository

This repository contains skills that demonstrate what's possible with Claude's skills system. These skills range from creative applications (art, music, design) to technical tasks (testing web apps, MCP server generation) to enterprise workflows (communications, branding, etc.).

Each skill is self-contained in its own folder with a `SKILL.md` file containing the instructions and metadata that Claude uses. Browse through these skills to get inspiration for your own skills or to understand different patterns and approaches.

Many skills in this repo are open source (Apache 2.0). We've also included the document creation & editing skills that power [Claude's document capabilities](https://www.anthropic.com/news/create-files) under the hood in the [`skills/docx`](./skills/docx), [`skills/pdf`](./skills/pdf), [`skills/pptx`](./skills/pptx), and [`skills/xlsx`](./skills/xlsx) subfolders. These are source-available, not open source, but we wanted to share these with developers as a reference for more complex skills that are actively used in a production AI application.

## Disclaimer

**These skills are provided for demonstration and educational purposes only.** While some of these capabilities may be available in Claude, the implementations and behaviors you receive from Claude may differ from what is shown in these skills. These skills are meant to illustrate patterns and possibilities. Always test skills thoroughly in your own environment before relying on them for critical tasks.

# Skill Sets
- [./skills](./skills): Skill examples for Creative & Design, Development & Technical, Enterprise & Communication, and Document Skills
- [./spec](./spec): The Agent Skills specification
- [./template](./template): Skill template

# Try in Claude Code, Claude.ai, and the API

## Claude Code
You can register this repository as a Claude Code Plugin marketplace by running the following command in Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills
```

Then, to install a specific set of skills:
1. Select `Browse and install plugins`
2. Select `anthropic-agent-skills`
3. Select `document-skills` or `example-skills`
4. Select `Install now`

Alternatively, directly install either Plugin via:
```
/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills
/plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills
```

After installing the plugin, you can use the skill by just mentioning it. For instance, if you install the `document-skills` plugin from the marketplace, you can ask Claude Code to do something like: "Use the PDF skill to extract the form fields from `path/to/some-file.pdf`"

## Claude.ai

These example skills are all already available to paid plans in Claude.ai. 

To use any skill from this repository or upload custom skills, follow the instructions in [Using skills in Claude](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512180-using-skills-in-claude#h_a4222fa77b).

## Claude API

You can use Anthropic's pre-built skills, and upload custom skills, via the Claude API. See the [Skills API Quickstart](https://docs.claude.com/en/api/skills-guide#creating-a-skill) for more.

# Creating a Basic Skill

Skills are simple to create - just a folder with a `SKILL.md` file containing YAML frontmatter and instructions. You can use the **template-skill** in this repository as a starting point:

```markdown
---
name: my-skill-name
description: A clear description of what this skill does and when to use it
---

# My Skill Name

[Add your instructions here that Claude will follow when this skill is active]

## Examples
- Example usage 1
- Example usage 2

## Guidelines
- Guideline 1
- Guideline 2
```

The frontmatter requires only two fields:
- `name` - A unique identifier for your skill (lowercase, hyphens for spaces)
- `description` - A complete description of what the skill does and when to use it

cloudflare/security-audit-skill.source_description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
cloudflare/security-audit-skill.source_readme:
# security-audit

A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor. It orchestrates isolated agents through reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting.

This is the skill that seeded Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness, described in [Build your own vulnerability harness](https://blog.cloudflare.com/build-your-own-vulnerability-harness). The harness grew into a multi-stage, fleet-wide system; this skill is the single-repo starting point it evolved from.

## What it does

The skill runs a structured audit in six phases:

1. **Reconnaissance** -- map architecture, trust boundaries, input surfaces, prior evidence, and deterministic coverage in `architecture.md` and `coverage-ledger.json`.
2. **Coverage-led hunting** -- assign isolated hunters from ledger units, record their checks, and use coverage critics to find gaps.
3. **Candidate validation** -- give every unique candidate to a fresh verifier that tries to disprove it.
4. **Structured output** -- write `confirmed`, `needs_validation`, and `rejected` records to `findings.json` and validate them against `report-schema.json`.
5. **Independent record verification** -- fresh agents verify final source claims. Material replacements receive another independent verifier.
6. **Target-neutral reporting** -- derive `REPORT.md`, `FINDINGS-DETAIL.md`, and `NEEDS-VALIDATION.md` from the verified records and coverage ledger.

The parent runs `validate-coverage-ledger.cjs` after creating the ledger and after each later ledger update. It runs `validate-findings.cjs` in Phase 4 and again after every Phase 5 replacement.

The verdicts are distinct: `confirmed` has a complete source trace and bounded observed result, `needs_validation` has an exact unresolved fact and no severity, and `rejected` records a disproved candidate.

Multiple runs against the same repo are additive. The skill uses prior ledgers and findings to target gaps, revalidate changed source, and carry forward current-source evidence without treating stale or unresolved work as covered.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `SKILL.md` | Setup, core principles, platform terminology, workflow overview, and audit anti-patterns |
| `RECONNAISSANCE.md` | Phase 1 reconnaissance prompts and synthesis instructions |
| `HUNTING.md` | Phase 2 orchestration, hunting methodology, and validation rules |
| `ATTACK-CLASSES.md` | Core, wildcard, and obvious-things attack prompts |
| `MEMORY-SAFETY-AND-BINARY.md` | Memory-safety, binary, and kernel hunting classes for native targets |
| `AI-AND-LLM.md` | Prompt-injection, agent/tool, and output-handling hunting classes for LLM-backed targets |
| `WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md` | HTTP request-framing, cache, and authentication-protocol hunting classes for HTTP-protocol and auth targets |
| `CLIENT-SIDE.md` | DOM-injection, messaging-trust, UI-redress, and prototype-pollution hunting classes for client-side/browser targets |
| `SUPPLY-CHAIN-AND-RELEASE.md` | Dependency, CI, release, signing, update, plugin, and extension hunting classes |
| `CLOUD-AND-DEPLOYMENT.md` | IAM, infrastructure-as-code, container, serverless, ingress, and runtime-configuration hunting classes |
| `PROTOCOLS-RPC-AND-MESSAGING.md` | RPC, serialization, queue, broker, webhook, and streaming-protocol hunting classes |
| `RESOURCE-EXHAUSTION-AND-AVAILABILITY.md` | Shared resource, quota, queue, worker, and operator-spend hunting classes |
| `DATA-ISOLATION-AND-LIFECYCLE.md` | Tenant isolation, cache, search, export, backup, migration, deletion, and restore hunting classes |
| `DESKTOP-MOBILE-AND-LOCAL-IPC.md` | Native app, deep-link, webview, exported-component, helper, daemon, and local-IPC hunting classes |
| `VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md` | Phases 3–6 candidate validation, structured output, record verification, and reporting |
| `report-schema.json` | JSON schema for all three `findings.json` verdicts |
| `validate-findings.cjs` | Zero-dependency validator for `findings.json` in Phases 4 and 5 |
| `validate-findings.test.cjs` | Findings-validator tests and producer-compatible fixture checks |
| `validate-coverage-ledger.cjs` | Zero-dependency validator for `coverage-ledger.json` in Phases 1–5 |
| `validate-coverage-ledger.test.cjs` | Coverage-ledger validator tests |

## Installation

Install the skill with the [Skills CLI](https://skills.sh):

```bash
npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill \
  --skill security-audit
```

Use `--global` for a user-level installation:

```bash
npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill \
  --skill security-audit \
  --global
```

Run `npx skills --help` for agent-selection and non-interactive options.

## Usage

Start your coding agent in (or pointed at) the codebase you want to audit, then ask it to do a security audit:

```
security audit this codebase
```

```

deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype.source_readme:
# dsh-superagent

> **Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product.** This code grew out of our team's day-to-day development work, with much of the engineering done by coding agents. Treat it as research code, not production-ready software. It may still contain bugs, and its coding style and engineering practices may be inconsistent. Review and adapt it before using it in your own environment.
>
> We have adapted it for publication, so it is not identical to our internal version or the implementation described in *Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System*. Some designs discussed in the article are directions for future development and are not implemented in this prototype.

dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/). It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.

It is also a way of working with an agent: **take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible.** An agent that can act for a whole team can also waste a whole team's attention, so it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when someone must act or can use a result. [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md) explains the principle and what it asks of the operator.

## Setup

Setup has many steps, so an agent does it with you. Ask your coding agent:

> Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.

It asks one short question at a time, shows the full plan once, and then installs and configures everything. [SETUP.md](SETUP.md) is what it follows.

## Documentation

Read the numbered documents in order; each builds only on the ones before it.

- [000 Philosophy](docs/000-philosophy.md)
- [001 Domain model](docs/001-domain.md)
- [002 Authorization](docs/002-authorization.md)
- [003 Execution](docs/003-execution.md)
- [004 Prompts](docs/004-prompts.md)
- [005 Panel](docs/005-panel.md)
- [006 Deployment](docs/006-deployment.md): manual setup, configuration, upgrades and troubleshooting
- [007 Architecture](docs/007-architecture.md)
- [008 Cookbook](docs/008-cookbook.md): adding a Source

## Development

`pnpm check` runs the typecheck, the tests and the build.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

donchitos/claude-code-game-studios.source_readme:
Claude Code Game Studios

Turn a single Claude Code session into a full game development studio.
49 agents. 74 skills. One coordinated AI team.

--- ## Why This Exists Building a game solo with AI is powerful — but a single chat session has no structure. No one stops you from hardcoding magic numbers, skipping design docs, or writing spaghetti code. There's no QA pass, no design review, no one asking "does this actually fit the game's vision?" **Claude Code Game Studios** solves this by giving your AI session the structure of a real studio. Instead of one general-purpose assistant, you get 49 specialized agents organized into a studio hierarchy — directors who guard the vision, department leads who own their domains, and specialists who do the hands-on work. Each agent has defined responsibilities, escalation paths, and quality gates. The result: you still make every decision, but now you have a team that asks the right questions, catches mistakes early, and keeps your project organized from first brainstorm to launch. --- ## Table of Contents - heydamir/unslop.source_readme:
# unslop

Created by Damir Sokolovsky ([@heydamir](https://x.com/heydamir)), who started the [Unslopping series](https://x.com/heydamir/status/2115063463063998736) on X.

![A vibecoded dashboard unslopping itself, frame by frame](skills/unslop/references/refs/story-dashboard-frames.webp)

unslop is a skill for Claude Code and Codex that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character. It finds the slop first, the purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy and uneven spacing, then sets a direction from your product and fixes the screen pass by pass like a designer doing a redline review. It works in whatever your screen is built with, like Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind or plain HTML and CSS, on dashboards, apps and landing pages, and even on a live site when all you have is a link.

## Install

For Claude Code, copy the skill into your skills folder.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.claude/skills/
```

For a single project, copy it into `.claude/skills/` inside that project instead.

For Codex, ask it to install the skill straight from this repo.

```
$skill-installer install https://github.com/heydamir/unslop/tree/main/skills/unslop
```

Or copy it by hand into `~/.agents/skills/`, or into `.agents/skills/` inside a single project.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.agents/skills/
```

To snapshot a live site or create a story video, install Playwright and its Chromium browser from the project directory where you run the skill:

```bash
npm install -D playwright
npx playwright install chromium
```

Story videos also require ffmpeg installed and available on your PATH.

## Use

In Claude Code, type `/unslop` with what you want. In Codex, type `$unslop` the same way. Or just ask in your own words and the agent picks the skill up by itself.

```
/unslop this dashboard
/unslop the hero of https://example.com
/unslop my landing page and make the story video so I can post it
```

It audits the screen and proposes a direction before it edits anything, so you can steer it early. If the screen is already good, it tells you so and suggests a few small refinements instead of redesigning it.

## What it does

- **Audit.** Lists every sign of slop with where it lives.
- **Direction.** Character, world, the one or two moments that carry the color, and a signature detail, all taken from your product.
- **Passes.** Spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion, in that order.
- **Visuals.** Shows your product instead of a glossy blob. When a hero needs a scene or an object, it can generate one through an image service like fal, Replicate, OpenAI images or Higgsfield. If none is connected, it offers to connect one as an MCP server, and it shows the prompt and asks before every paid generation. Dashboards and apps rarely need one.
- **Story video.** A square video under 10 seconds of your screen unslopping itself, ready to post. It needs Playwright and ffmpeg.

Try it on the two vibecoded screens in [examples](examples).

## Hire the unslopper

Would rather have a designer do it? Damir unslops one key screen in 3 days, built in your stack, at [heydamir.design/unslop](https://heydamir.design/unslop).

## License

[CC BY 4.0](LICENSE). Use it, change it and share it, including commercially, as long as you credit Damir Sokolovsky ([@heydamir](https://x.com/heydamir)) and link back to this repository.

multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills.source_description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills.source_readme:
# Karpathy-Inspired Claude Code Guidelines

> Check out my new project [Multica](https://github.com/multica-ai/multica) — an open-source platform for running and managing coding agents with reusable skills.
>
> Follow me on X: [https://x.com/jiayuan_jy](https://x.com/jiayuan_jy)

A single `CLAUDE.md` file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from [Andrej Karpathy's observations](https://x.com/karpathy/status/2015883857489522876) on LLM coding pitfalls.

English | [简体中文](./README.zh.md)

## The Problems

From Andrej's post:

> "The models make wrong assumptions on your behalf and just run along with them without checking. They don't manage their confusion, don't seek clarifications, don't surface inconsistencies, don't present tradeoffs, don't push back when they should."

> "They really like to overcomplicate code and APIs, bloat abstractions, don't clean up dead code... implement a bloated construction over 1000 lines when 100 would do."

> "They still sometimes change/remove comments and code they don't sufficiently understand as side effects, even if orthogonal to the task."

## The Solution

Four principles in one file that directly address these issues:

| Principle | Addresses |
|-----------|-----------|
| **Think Before Coding** | Wrong assumptions, hidden confusion, missing tradeoffs |
| **Simplicity First** | Overcomplication, bloated abstractions |
| **Surgical Changes** | Orthogonal edits, touching code you shouldn't |
| **Goal-Driven Execution** | Leverage through tests-first, verifiable success criteria |

## The Four Principles in Detail

### 1. Think Before Coding

**Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.**

LLMs often pick an interpretation silently and run with it. This principle forces explicit reasoning:

- **State assumptions explicitly** — If uncertain, ask rather than guess
- **Present multiple interpretations** — Don't pick silently when ambiguity exists
- **Push back when warranted** — If a simpler approach exists, say so
- **Stop when confused** — Name what's unclear and ask for clarification

### 2. Simplicity First

**Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.**

Combat the tendency toward overengineering:

- No features beyond what was asked
- No abstractions for single-use code
- No "flexibility" or "configurability" that wasn't requested
- No error handling for impossible scenarios
- If 200 lines could be 50, rewrite it

**The test:** Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated? If yes, simplify.

### 3. Surgical Changes

**Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.**

When editing existing code:

- Don't "improve" adjacent code, comments, or formatting
- Don't refactor things that aren't broken
- Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently
- If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it — don't delete it

When your changes create orphans:

- Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused
- Don't remove pre-existing dead code unless asked

**The test:** Every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.

### 4. Goal-Driven Execution

**Define success criteria. Loop until verified.**

Transform imperative tasks into verifiable goals:

| Instead of... | Transform to... |
|--------------|-----------------|
| "Add validation" | "Write tests for invalid inputs, then make them pass" |
| "Fix the bug" | "Write a test that reproduces it, then make it pass" |
| "Refactor X" | "Ensure tests pass before and after" |

For multi-step tasks, state a brief plan:

```
1. [Step] → verify: [check]
2. [Step] → verify: [check]
3. [Step] → verify: [check]
```

Strong success criteria let the LLM loop independently. Weak criteria ("make it work") require constant clarification.

## Install

**Option A: Claude Code Plugin (recommended)**

From within Claude Code, first add the marketplace:
```
/plugin marketplace add forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills
```

Then install the plugin:
```
/plugin install andrej-karpathy-skills@karpathy-skills
```

This installs the guidelines as a Claude Code plugin, making the skill available across all your projects.

**Option B: CLAUDE.md (per-project)**

New project:
```bash
curl -o CLAUDE.md https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills/main/CLAUDE.md
```

Existing project (append):
```bash
echo "" >> CLAUDE.md
curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills/main/CLAUDE.md >> CLAUDE.md
```

## Using with Cursor

This repository includes a committed Cursor project rule ([`.cursor/rules/karpathy-guidelines.mdc`](.cursor/rules/karpathy-guidelines.mdc)) so the same guidelines apply when you open the project in Cursor. See **[CURSOR.md](CURSOR.md)** for setup, using the rule in other projects, and how this relates to Claude Code.

## Key Insight

From Andrej:

> "LLMs are exceptionally good at looping until they meet specific goals... Don't tell it what to do, give it success criteria and watch it go."

# Hallmark **A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated.** [usehallmark.com](https://www.usehallmark.com)  ·  fifty themes  ·  custom on request  ·  redesign and audit by name Made by Together AI.

Hallmark holds a hard floor and then gets out of the way. It deals three themes from a catalog of fifty materials, builds the page around what the visitor came to do, and lints the result in a real browser against the tells that read as machine-made: the eyebrow above every heading, tracked-capital labels, one coloured word in a headline, a page of empty frames or nothing but photographs, a hero that misses its screen, an email sign-up at the end of every page, a form that says thanks without sending anything. A fresh-context reviewer gets the last word. The gates come in tiers. patch-gg/pixelfx.source_readme: # pixelfx. **244 pixel art effects and animations, every one a small piece of code.** Fire, explosions, magic, weather, UI, pickups, critters and more. Play them live, recolor and mirror them, drop them into a browser game, or export sprite sheets for any engine. Plus a Claude Code skill that makes new ones the way a picky pixel artist would: draft, render, look, refine. Every effect that involves a character is **acted out**: he winds up, lets go, freezes on contact and recovers, and a target takes the hit. Twelve whole moves chain the effects into attacks from wind-up to recovery. **[open the gallery](https://patch-gg.github.io/pixelfx/)** · [catalog](docs/CATALOG.md) · [acting](#acting) · [the skill](#the-skill) · [make your own](#make-your-own) · [how it works](#how-it-works) The method is [Hugo Duprez](https://x.com/HugoDuprez)'s, from [How to make (good) pixel art effects with Claude](https://www.spritefusion.com/blog/how-to-make-good-pixel-art-effects-with-claude): code is clay, trust your eyes, feed your references. His [open-source effects](https://www.spritefusion.com/pixel-art-vfx) at Sprite Fusion set the bar, and `src/core/sim.js` and the effects that say so at the top adapt his code. This repo is our take on the idea at library scale, with a skill to keep going. ## what's in it. | category | effects | some of them | |---|---|---| | **moves** | 12 | arrow shot, dash strike, earth stomp, fireball throw, ground pound, holy smite… | | **fire** | 12 | brazier, campfire, candle, fire breath, fire ring, fire tornado… | | **explosions** | 12 | barrel explosion, big explosion, cartoon 12 | achievement, coin collect, combo counter, confetti, countdown, crit number… | | **pickups** | 11 | chest open, coin spin, collect burst, crystal shard, gem spin, heart pickup… | | **transitions** | 10 | blinds, burn away, crt off, diamond wipe, glitch wipe, iris… | | **critters** | 12 | bat, bird, butterfly, eyeball, fish school, flying skull… | Every effect is a file in `src/fx//.js`. The [catalog](docs/CATALOG.md) lists them all. ## use one. **In a browser game** (canvas, Phaser, PixiJS, Kaplay, three.js), use the code. pbakaus/impeccable.source_readme:
# Impeccable

The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with `polish` and `bolder`, review with `critique` and `audit`, and catch AI slop before it ships.

From your project root:

```bash
npx impeccable install
```

Reload your coding tool, then run `/impeccable init` in your agent (`$impeccable init` on Codex).

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Replit Agent, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, Kiro, Trae, Rovo Dev, Qoder, Mistral Vibe, Pi, Hermes Agent, DeepSeek Harness, and Veto. Full docs live at [impeccable.style/docs](https://impeccable.style/docs).

| Without Impeccable | With Impeccable |
|---|---|
| ![Villa Castagneto built without Impeccable: cream background, a thin serif headline with an italic accent, two pill buttons, and flat vector illustrations in rounded cards](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable/raw/main/docs/images/readme-without.webp) | ![Villa Castagneto built with Impeccable: a full-bleed engraved night scene of the villa on its cliff above the sea, a condensed cream and vermilion headline, and a month strip along the bottom](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable/raw/main/docs/images/readme-with.webp) |

Same model (Fable 5.1), same brief: a fourteen-room family guesthouse on the Ligurian coast. Without Impeccable, it builds the tasteful default: cream page, thin serif, italic accent, pill buttons. With it, the page is built around one picture: the house at night, seen from the water.

For a full project, see the [Neo Mirai case study](https://impeccable.style/cases/neo-mirai): a conference site taken from mockup to shipped page.

## Why

Inter for everything. Purple-to-blue gradients. Cards nested in cards, gray text on colored backgrounds, a rounded-square icon tile above every heading. Ask an agent for a page with no other guidance and these show up again and again, across models and projects.

- **Words for what you want.** "Make it pop" leaves your agent to guess. `/impeccable bolder the pricing cards` loads a playbook written for that one move and points it at one target.
- **A reviewer.** `critique` scores the design against usability heuristics and ranks what to fix first. `audit` checks accessibility, performance, theming, and responsive behavior, with findings ranked P0 (blocking) to P3 (polish).
- **A slop detector.** 62 deterministic rules flag the tells above, plus quality problems like cramped padding and skipped headings. No LLM, no API key.

Impeccable is strongest on interfaces that already exist: point it at a page or a component and iterate. It builds new pages too; see [Build something new](https://impeccable.style/docs/new-work) for how to get the most out of that harder mode. To start, pick one component:

```
/impeccable critique the pricing cards
```

## How it works

Run `/impeccable init` once per project. It reads your code, asks only what it can't infer (who the product is for, what it needs to do, the constraints), and writes `PRODUCT.md`. Every later command reads it. Run `/impeccable document` to capture your existing visual system in `DESIGN.md`, so changes stay on-brand. [More on context files](https://impeccable.style/docs/context).

Then name a command and a target:

```
/impeccable critique the onboarding flow
/impeccable quieter the landing page
/impeccable polish settings
/impeccable harden checkout
```

Or just describe what you want: `/impeccable redo this hero section`. Narrow targets get better results; a single section reviewed closely beats a whole page at a glance. Pin a command you use often with `/impeccable pin audit` to get `/audit` as its own shortcut.

### 24 commands

| | Commands |
|---|---|
| **Steer** | `bolder` amplifies safe designs · `quieter` tones down loud ones · `distill` removes what the page doesn't need · `colorize` brings color to a gray interface · `typeset` fixes fonts, hierarchy, and sizing · `layout` fixes spacing and rhythm · `animate` adds transitions and interaction feedback · `delight` adds personality · `overdrive` goes for shaders, spring physics, and scroll-driven effects |
| **Review** | `critique` is a scored UX review · `audit` is a technical quality report |
| **Finish** | `polish` is the final pass before shipping · `harden` covers errors, i18n, overflow, and edge cases · `clarify` rewrites unclear copy · `adapt` handles screen sizes and devices · `optimize` fixes loading and rendering performance · `onboard` designs first-run flows and empty states |
| **Iterate live** | `live` lets you pick an element in the browser and cycle through variants · `generate` produces variants of a named element without manual picking |
| **Plan and set up** | `shape` plans UX before code · `init` writes `PRODUCT.md` · `document` writes `DESIGN.md` · `extract` pulls repeated patterns into your design system |

The 24th, `craft`, is a deprecated alias for a plain build request. Type `/impeccable` alone to see the list in your agent. Each command has its own page:
pbakaus/impeccable.description: В этой подборке представлен Impeccable — набор команд для улучшения дизайна, управляемый через подсказки в код‑агенте. Проект предлагает словарь действий (polish, bolder, critique, audit) для точного управления внешним видом и качества интерфейсов, позволяя агенту выполнять целевые правки, оценивать юзабилити и проверять доступность без обращения к LLM. После однократного `/impeccable init` создаётся файл PRODUCT.md, а последующие команды читают его и, при необходимости, генерируют DESIGN.md. Инструмент работает с множеством популярных код‑агентов и поддерживает 24 команды, охватывающие стилизацию, ревью, финальную полировку и живую итерацию.

pingdotgg/t3code.source_readme:
# T3 Code

T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app ([iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/t3-code-remote-claude-more/id6787819824), [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.t3tools.t3code)), [web app](https://app.t3.codes) and [Electron-based desktop app](https://t3.codes).

Works with your subscriptions on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Google Antigravity. If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them.

## "Wait, what are you selling me?"

Nothing. We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents. We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar.

We wanted something performant, remote-ready, and truly open. If we ever go the wrong direction, we want you to have everything you need to fork and build the editor that you want.

## Installation

> [!WARNING]
> T3 Code currently supports Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Antigravity. Install and authenticate at least one provider before use:
>
> - Codex: install [Codex CLI](https://developers.openai.com/codex/cli) and run `codex login`
> - Claude: install [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code) and run `claude auth login`
> - Cursor: install [Cursor CLI](https://cursor.com/cli) and run `agent login`
> - Grok Build: install [Grok Build CLI](https://x.ai/cli) and run `grok login`
> - OpenCode: install [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) and run `opencode auth login`
> - Antigravity: enable it in Settings, then use **Install Antigravity** and **Sign in with Google**. No CLI is required.

### Command line

```bash
curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh
```

On Windows, in PowerShell:

```powershell
irm https://t3.codes/install.ps1 | iex
```

Then run `t3` to start the server and open the local web app. `t3 service install` keeps it running in the background, `t3 update` moves to a newer release, and `t3 --help` has the full reference.

To try it once without installing, run `npx t3@latest` instead.

### Desktop app

Install the latest version of the desktop app from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/releases), or from your favorite package registry:

#### Windows (`winget`)

```bash
winget install T3Tools.T3Code
```

#### Windows (`scoop`)

```bash
scoop install extras/t3code
```

#### macOS (Homebrew)

```bash
brew install --cask t3-code
```

#### Debian, Ubuntu (`.deb`)

Download the `.deb` from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/releases), then:

```bash
sudo apt install ./T3-Code-*.deb
```

#### Arch Linux (AUR)

Stable:

```bash
yay -S t3code-bin
```

Nightly:

```bash
yay -S t3code-nightly-bin
```

The AUR packaging is maintained in this repository under [`packaging/aur`](./packaging/aur).

#### Nix (nixpkgs)

```bash
nix profile add github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixos-unstable#t3code
```

The package is maintained in [nixpkgs](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/tree/nixos-unstable/pkgs/by-name/t3/t3code)
and includes the desktop app (`t3code-desktop`) and the `t3` command.
See [Nix installation](./docs/user/install.md#nix-nixpkgs) for NixOS configuration and updates.

## Some notes

We are very very early in this project. Expect bugs.

We are (mostly) not accepting contributions yet. Small fixes may be considered. Big features will not be.

## Documentation

Full docs live in [docs/](./docs). There's no docs site yet.

- [FAQ](./docs/user/faq.md)
- [Install and first run](./docs/user/install.md)
- [Permission modes](./docs/user/permission-modes.md)
- [Keyboard shortcuts](./docs/user/keybindings.md)
- [Project settings](./docs/user/project-settings.md)
- [Appearance preferences](./docs/user/appearance.md)
- [Remote access from a phone or another machine](./docs/user/remote-access.md)
- [Connect Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT and other agents over MCP](./docs/user/outside-agents.md)
- [Keeping app and server in sync](./docs/user/updating.md)
- [Source control integrations](./docs/user/source-control.md)
- Multiple accounts: [Codex](./docs/user/providers-codex.md) · [Claude](./docs/user/providers-claude.md)
- [Run T3 Code as a background service](./docs/user/background-service.md)

Building from source? Start at [docs/internals/overview.md](./docs/internals/overview.md).

## If you REALLY want to contribute still.... read this first

### Install `vp`

T3 Code uses Vite+ so you'll need to install the global `vp` command-line tool.

#### macOS / Linux

```bash
curl -fsSL https://vite.plus | bash
```

#### Windows

```bash
irm https://vite.plus/ps1 | iex
```

Checkout their getting started guide for more information: https://viteplus.dev/guide/

### Install dependencies

```bash
vp i
```

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) before reporting a bug or opening a PR.

Have a feature request? Start an [Ideas discussion](https://github.com/pingdotgg

# 手机去广告 关掉国产安卓手机系统里的广告、热搜、资讯推荐和营销推送。 介绍页：**https://rddmwmddr.github.io/android-ad-cleaner/** ## 下载桌面客户端 插上手机，点几下按钮。不需要 Python，也不需要 AI 工具。 > **v0.3.0 · 2026-11-01**：修 0.2.9 之后社区报告的十几个问题（华为同名渠道行、vivo 旧系统和「运营消息」渠道、安卓 17 页面没画完就找入口、小米商店误点、OPPO 关快应用后快递卡片打不开、POCO 广告组件、连接提示品牌认错等）；新增 vivo X Fold6、Redmi Note 14 5G、一加 Ace 6T、小米 14 Pro 机型脚本和新机型适配辅助 `run.py adapt`；引擎重构，用法不变。旧版不会自动更新，0.2.7 起的客户端左下角会提示新版；请重新下载，已有备份会保留。详见 [更新说明](https://github.com/rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner/releases)，错误日志上报说明见 [这里](docs/12-错误日志上报.md)。官网：https://ahuamiao.com/sites/other/android-ad-removal-intro.html 此前版本已处理 Windows 本地页面超时、荣耀截图越界、通知渠道误操作风险、vivo 快应用与备份问题。各 Issue 的处理范围和待验证项见 [社区问题处理记录](docs/09-社区问题处理.md)。仅支持通过 adb 连接的安卓设备，暂不支持使用 HDC 的原生鸿蒙。 | 电脑 | 下载 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | Mac · Apple 芯片（M1 及以后） | [AndroidAdCleaner-0.3.0-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner/releases/download/v0.3.0/AndroidAdCleaner-0.3.0-mac-arm64.dmg) | 已签名、通过苹果公证，双击就能打开 | | Mac · Intel 芯片（macOS 11 及以上） | [AndroidAdCleaner-0.3.0-mac-intel.dmg](https://github.com/rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner/releases/download/v0.3.0/AndroidAdCleaner-0.3.0-mac-intel.dmg) | 同上 | | Windows 10 / 11 · 安装版 | [AndroidAdCleaner-0.3.0-windows-setup.exe](https://github.com/rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner/releases/download/v0.3.0/AndroidAdCleaner-0.3.0-windows-setup.exe) | 弹「Windows 已保护你的电脑」时点「更多信息」→「仍要运行」 | | Windows 10 / 11 · 免安装 | [AndroidAdCleaner-0.3.0-windows-portable.zip](https://github.com/rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner/releases/download/v0.3.0/AndroidAdCleaner-0.3.0-windows-portable.zip) | 解压后双击 `AndroidAdCleaner.exe` | 不知道 Mac 是哪种芯片：左上角苹果图标 → 关于本机，「芯片」写 Apple M 开头的选 Apple 芯片。所有版本：[Releases](https://github.com/rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner/releases)。用法：[docs/08-桌面客户端.md](docs/08-桌面客户端.md)。 | | | |---|---| |
**1 连接手机**：插线即认出手机，内置开启 USB 调试的图文教程 |
**2 检测**：型号、系统版本、机型脚本、快应用、广告组件 | |
**3 选择要关的**：营销通知按渠道勾选，服务类默认不勾 |
**4 执行**：进度条和实时日志 | |
**5 完成**：每一步的结果，最后提醒关闭开发者模式 |
**反馈**：自动附诊断信息，一键提交 GitHub Issue | --- - 不 root，不解锁，不刷机，系统更新不受影响。 - 只拨系统和 App 自带的开关。挂起广告包这一步要机主点头，一条命令可以还原。 - 搜索、负一屏卡片、应用商店的安装和更新、天气预警、快递提醒，这些功能保留。

改之前：OPPO 软件商店首页。轮播图、必备、必玩、福利标签，全是推广位。

--- ## 处理哪些东西 | 类别 | 例子 | 怎么处理 | |---|---|---| | 系统广告 | 个性化广告、广告跟踪（OAID）、智能推荐服务 | 系统设置里的开关 | | 热搜和资讯 | 下拉搜索的热榜、负一屏资讯、浏览器信息流 | 各 App 设置里的开关，浏览器切到简洁首页 | | 推广位 | 商店的轮播、开屏、悬浮活动、签到福利 | 商店「服务管理」里的开关 | | 营销推送 | 各 App 的「内容与营销」「活动优惠」通知 | 按渠道关，同一个 App 的订单、快递、更新通知保留 | | 广告组件 | `com.opos.ads`、`com.miui.systemAdSolution` 等 | `pm suspend` 挂起，要机主同意 | | 快应用 | 广告里一点就跳进去的「免安装小程序」 | `quickapp` 检测，`quickapp off` 关闭，见 [docs/07-快应用.md](docs/07-快应用.md) | ## 不做的事 - 不卸载、不停用系统应用（`pm uninstall`、`pm disable-user` 都不用）。 - 不改 system 分区，不装模块。 - 不替你同意任何 App 的用户协议。遇到协议页，点「取消」或「以后再说」。 - 不截账号页和手机号页。 --- ## 四种用法

> 用法一要先在手机上打开开发者模式和 USB 调试，带截图的教程：[docs/00-打开开发者模式.md](docs/00-打开开发者模式.md)。 | 用法 | 适合谁 | 要准备什么 | 文档 | |---|---|---|---| | **一：AI 智能体替你跑** | 有电脑，想省事 | 电脑、数据线、一个能执行命令的 AI 工具 | [docs/02-用AI智能体.md](docs/02-用AI智能体.md) | | **二：聊天 AI 带你点** | 只有手机 | DeepSeek、豆包、ChatGPT 任意一个 | [docs/03-用聊天AI.md](docs/03-用聊天AI.md) | | **三：照清单手动关** | 想自己掌握每一步 | 只要手机 | [docs/清单/](docs/清单/) | | **四：桌面客户端** | 不想敲命令 | Mac（Apple / Intel 芯片）或 Windows 10/11、数据线 | [下载](#下载桌面客户端) · [说明](docs/08-桌面客户端.md) | 用法一的开场白，复制给 AI： ```text 请克隆 https://github.com/rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner ，读仓库里的 AGENTS.md， 然后帮我给连着电脑的这台手机去广告。每一步改之前告诉我要改什么。 ``` --- ## 实测过的机型 **机型脚本**：一台机型的自动操作步骤，记着「打开哪个 App、点哪几个字进设置页、关哪几个开关、留哪几个」。电脑照着它在手机上点，几分钟做完。设置页因型号和系统版本而不同，所以每个机型一份。 | 品牌 | 机型（型号） | 系统 | 机型脚本 | 手动清单 | 营销通知 | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 魅族 | 21 Pro（MEIZU 21 Pro） | Flyme 12.6.0.0A / Android 16 | ⚠️ 10-30 真机分段验证目标均已关闭；从开启状态自动关闭待验证，其他版本停止 | ✅ | ✅ 本机 8 个营销渠道 | | 华为 | ALN-AL00 | HarmonyOS 4.2.0.223 / Android 12 | ⚠️ 营销通知命令行工具，需先人工审核清单，客户端不自动运行；[用法](docs/清单/华为-ALN-AL00-营销通知.md) | [范围与路径](docs/清单/华为-HarmonyOS.md) | 本次人工审核 79 个候选：关闭 48 个、31 个原已整体屏蔽；不代表新脚本整轮成绩 | | 荣耀 | PNM-AN10 | MagicOS 10 | ✅ 实测通过，重跑 4 分钟 | ✅ | ✅ 26 个渠道 | | 荣耀 | WKL-AN20 | MagicOS 11.0.0.111 / Android 17 | ⚠️ 2026-10-28 路径逐项实测，新脚本整轮待复测、用时未测；音乐需手动开页，见[说明](recipes/honor-WKL-AN20/README.md) | ✅ | ✅ 人工关闭 13 个渠道，其他渠道和总开关未变 | | 一加 | Ace 2 Pro（PJA110） | ColorOS 14.0.0.812 / Android 14 | 源码新增：3 项个性化 + 6 项商店推广位关闭并回读 | 部分，见实测记录 | ✅ 23 个，总开关不变；天气提醒差异见实测 | | 一加 | 13T（PKX110） | ColorOS 16.0.10.500 / Android 16 | ✅ 2026-10-28 实测：广告跟踪 76 项、商店两段、小布建议；浏览器/下拉搜索/负一屏见清单差异 | ✅ | ✅ 17 个渠道 | | 一加 | Ace 6T（PLR110） | ColorOS 17.0.0.101 / Android 17 | ✅ 2026-10-31 贡献者真机九段全跑 224 秒；本仓库无该机型，未复测，见[清单差异](docs/清单/OPPO-ColorOS.md) | ✅ | —（未测） | | OPPO | Find N6（PLP120） | ColorOS 16.0.9 | ⚠️ 路径实测，整段待验证
rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner.description: Android‑Ad‑Cleaner – утилита для отключения рекламных и маркетинговых элементов в системах отечественных Android‑устройств без рут‑прав, разблокировки или прошивки. Программа подключается к телефону через ADB, определяет модель и версию системы, а затем переключает системные и приложенческие переключатели, приостанавливает рекламные компоненты и отключает быстрые приложения. Поддерживается несколько способов использования: от полностью автоматизированного запуска через AI‑агента до ручного управления через графический клиент для macOS и Windows. Отключаемые элементы включают системную рекламу, горячие поисковые запросы, новостные ленты, рекламные места в магазинах приложений и маркетинговые push‑уведомления, при этом сохраняются полезные функции, такие как уведомления о заказах и погоде. Операция обратима одной командой, а обновления системы не влияют на результаты.
rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner.joke: Почему рекламный баннер ушёл в отпуск? Потому что его отключили и он наконец нашёл свободное время!

# 紫微斗数 · 开源排盘引擎 ### 算法是公开的传统智慧，不应该被锁在围墙里 [![CI](https://github.com/Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Dataset: CC BY 4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/dataset-CC%20BY%204.0-green.svg)](./DATASET-LICENSE) **中文** · [English](./README.en.md)
**一、项目理念**：紫微斗数是中国传统命理学的瑰宝，倪海厦老师在《天纪》中系统梳理了正宗的紫微斗数体系。我们希望通过技术手段让更多人接触和学习这门学问。 开源排盘算法和知识库，是因为我们相信：**算法是公开的传统智慧，不应该被锁在围墙里**。真正的价值在于解读的深度、用户体验的打磨、以及持续运营的积累。 **二、项目信息**：基于倪海厦《天纪》教学体系的紫微斗数排盘系统，包含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据，以及一套完整开源的紫微斗数解读数据：**v4.0 解读数据集——67.5 万张命盘 × 13 维 = 877 万段解读，正文约 204 亿字，解压后 56.6 GB**（2026-10-15 发布）。 | 数据集 | 命盘 | 解读段数 | 解压后 | 覆盖年份 | 每张盘解读字数 | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | **v4.0 解读数据集**（2026-10-15） | **674,976** | **8,774,688** | **56.6 GB** | **1950–2026**（只含真实日期） | **约 3.0 万字** | | v3.0 样本数据集 | 518,400 | 6,739,200 | 33.1 GB | 1924–1983 | 约 2.1 万字 | | 变化 | +30% | +30% | **+71%** | +17 年 | +44% | v3.0 每张盘解读字数按 2,160 张盘抽样估算，其余数字为全量统计；两版每张盘都是 13 维。 在线体验：[ouranic.cn](https://ouranic.cn/?from=gh-readme)，排盘、AI 解读、命盘历史全部开放。 > **注：关于六亲判断** > > 紫微斗数在六亲（父母、兄弟、子女等）判断上存在一定局限。倪师在《天纪》中指出：“斗数批六亲本来就比较差一点。”（[2上 · 00:25:27](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1KJsLekEfA?p=3&t=1527)）在传统术数中，铁板神数在核对六亲方面有其独特优势（[2上 · 00:25:43](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1KJsLekEfA?p=3&t=1543)）。因此，与六亲相关的分析仅供参考；[ouranic.cn](https://ouranic.cn/?from=gh-readme) 上父母、兄弟、子女三个维度也附有同样的说明。 --- ## 目录 | | 章节 | 一句话 | valentderah/totk-pc-recomp.source_description: Static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom to native Windows x86-64, with a Vulkan renderer. Game files not included.
valentderah/totk-pc-recomp.source_readme:
# TotK Recomp

**TotK Recomp** is a static recompilation of *The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom* (Nintendo Switch, 2023) into a native x86-64 application for Windows and Linux ([docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **No game files are included.** You need your own legally obtained copy of *Tears of the Kingdom*, dumped from your own console: the base game and the 1.1.0, 1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update. Instructions for obtaining those files will not be provided.
>
> The game is built from your files on your machine, so the result contains the game. It is for your own use. Do not share it.

## Status

Early development. The game is playable on Windows and Linux; visual bugs and crashes are still expected.

Report problems as issues, following [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Features

- Native code, not emulation
- Game updates 1.1.0, 1.2.1 and 1.4.3; 1.2.1 and 1.4.3 saves carry over between them
- 60 fps by default; up to 144 fps or the monitor's refresh rate (experimental)
- Custom resolutions (1080p, 2k...), supersampling and AMD FSR 1 upscaling
- HDR10 output with peak, game and HUD brightness settings
- 16:10 (Steam Deck, handhelds), 21:9 and 32:9 (ultrawide) game resolutions, with the camera and the interface in that shape
- Anisotropic texture filtering up to 16x, for sharp ground into the distance
- In-game settings menu (F1) and performance overlay (F10)
- Setup and in-game menu in English, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese
- Keyboard, mouse and gamepad with remapping, rumble and gyro
- Xbox button prompts: LB, RB, LT, RT, Menu and View, and A, B, X and Y as labelled on the button to press, with either button layout
- Shaders prepared at install instead of during play
- Mods made for emulators: unpack a mod into the `mods` folder next to `totk.exe`; switch and order them in the menu. RomFS
  mods, TKMM's merged output and ExeFS code patches (`.ips`, `.pchtxt`) work; the game rebuilds itself for code patches
  ([docs/tester-guide.md](docs/tester-guide.md), "Mods")
- Atmosphère cheats: put a cheat file into a mod and switch its cheats in the menu ([docs/cheats.md](docs/cheats.md))

## Planned

- VRR

## Installing

### Windows

Requirements: Windows 10 or later, an x86-64 CPU with SSE4.2 (AVX2/FMA machines get a faster build), a GPU with Vulkan 1.3 and `VK_EXT_external_memory_host`, about 36 GiB free during setup (20 GiB after).

1. Download `TotK-Setup-<version>-windows.zip` from [Releases](../../releases/latest) and unpack it.
2. Start `TotK-Setup.exe`. If SmartScreen warns about an unsigned app, choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
3. Pick your game files, the language and an install folder, and press *Start*. The setup builds the game once.
4. Play `totk.exe` from the install folder.

### Linux

Requirements: as on Windows, plus Linux 6.7 or later and glibc 2.34 or later (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 35, SteamOS 3).

1. Download `TotK-Setup-x86_64.AppImage` from [Releases](../../releases/latest), or build it ([docs/installer.md](docs/installer.md), "Linux release").
2. Make it executable (`chmod +x TotK-Setup-x86_64.AppImage`) and start it. On a Steam Deck, do this in Desktop Mode.
3. Pick your game files, the language and an install folder, and press *Start*.
4. Play `totk` from the install folder.

To update, run a newer setup on the same folder; saves and settings are kept. Settings are in the in-game menu and in `totk.ini` ([totk.ini.example](totk.ini.example) lists every key). Controls: [docs/controls.md](docs/controls.md).

## Credits

TotK Recomp builds on the projects below. What was taken from each, with its license, is listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

- [LAS Recomp](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp)
- [MacNativeGames](https://github.com/ly05010419/MacNativeGames)
- [d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile) and [nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)
- [SavageWindRecomp](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp)
- [Ryujinx](https://github.com/Ryujinx/Ryujinx)
- [deko3d](https://github.com/devkitPro/deko3d)
- [hactool](https://github.com/SciresM/hactool)
- [SDL 3](https://libsdl.org), [Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui), [AMD FSR 1](https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR), [Vulkan Memory Allocator](https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator), [libopus](https://opus-codec.org), [libvpx](https://chromium.googlesource.com/webm/libvpx), [Zstandard](https://github.com/facebook/zstd)
- [Switchbrew](https://switchbrew.org) and the Switch homebrew community

## License

The project's own code is under the [MIT License](LICENSE); third-party code keeps its own license ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)). The license grants nothing for Nintendo's game.

wangzan101/mika.description: Mika — это AI‑ассистент, работающий полностью на Android‑устройстве. Пользователь формулирует задачу одной фразой, а агент открывает нужные приложения или веб‑страницы, имитирует нажатия, вводит текст и скроллит, пока задача не будет выполнена, при этом основной экран остаётся свободным. Приложение взаимодействует с другими программами без специальных API, полагаясь на визуальное распознавание элементов, и может быть вызвано из встроенного браузера. Все данные остаются на устройстве, а модель ИИ подключается через пользовательский API‑ключ (ChatGPT, xAI, OpenRouter и др.). Проект распространяется под лицензией Apache‑2.0.

message_texts.overview:
*ТЕСТ: обновлённое саммари*

В этой подборке представлены репозитории, ориентированные на разные задачи агентных систем\. Первый проект — security‑audit‑skill от Cloudflare — предлагает навык для многоэтапных проверок кода с машинно‑читаемыми результатами\. Для контроля качества генерируемого кода включены навыки anti‑AI‑slop \(Nutlope/hallmark\) и design‑vocabulary \(pbakaus/impeccable\), которые отфильтровывают AI‑созданный контент и позволяют проводить ревью и аудит\. Claude‑seo \(AgriciDaniel/claude\-seo\) реализует комплексный набор подзадач SEO‑аудита и генерации отчётов\. Persistent‑context \(thedotmack/claude\-mem\) сохраняет и сжимает историю взаимодействий агента, возвращая релевантный контекст в будущих сессиях\. Наконец, TradingAgents \(TauricResearch/TradingAgents\) представляет фреймворк многопользовательских LLM‑агентов для автоматизированной финансовой торговли\.

Уточнения к первым тестовым карточкам: в Impeccable без LLM работает отдельный детектор, а не все команды для код\-агента\. Local\-first в Orkas не означает отсутствие обращений к облачным моделям\. Эти формулировки в прежних карточках были слишком широкими\.
